SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-22-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-22-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF IS PRESENT JONATHAN KAPLAN. DEFENDANT IS PRESENT ANDREA STEINER. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED (CROSS CASE CSM 18-858868) JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-22-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KAPLAN, JONATHAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT STEINER, ANDREA $2,601.68 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,676.68, LANDLORD DID NOT PROVIDE ESTIMATE OF WITHHOLDINGS FROM SECURITY DEPOSIT OF $13,550 WITHIN 21 DAYS OF TENANT'S DEPARTURE, AND SO LANDLORD BEARS THE BURDEN OF DEMONSTRATING AMOUNTS WERE PROPERLY WITHHELD. LANDLORD HAS NOT CARRIED THAT BURDEN; HER INVOICES DO NO DOCUMENT WHAT WORK WAS PERFORMED OR WHETHER IT WAS NECESSARY. THE COURT DOES NOT FIND BAD FAITH. THE ORIGINAL PAYMENT TENANT MADE WAS FOR 20,450. THE ACTUAL SECURITY DEPOSIT WAS THEREFORE 13,550, NOT 13,800. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, THE JUDGMENT IN THIS ACTION HAS BEEN PAID IN FULL OR OTHERWISE SATISFIED. AS TO DEFENDANT STEINER, ANDREA
